Master Glasses Scanner to protect your personal space from hidden smart glasses, camera eyewear, RTSP IP cameras, and spy recording devices.
1. Real-Time Radar Scanner & GATT Deep Inspect
The central Radar uses Low-Latency BLE scanning to detect smart glasses nearby. Use GATT Deep Inspect on suspicious unknown devices to uncover hidden manufacturer information.
2. AI Visual Scan, ML Kit & Magnetic EMF Sensor
AI Scan uses Google ML Kit face detection and camera frame inspection to check for recording LEDs. Toggle the Magnetic EMF Detector to locate hidden electronics and lenses behind mirrors or walls.
Wi-Fi Deep Scan sweeps local hotel or Airbnb networks to detect hidden IP cameras streaming video over RTSP ports (554, 8080).
Set a 100m Auto-Zone perimeter on the Tactical Map or toggle Zone Security in private areas for automatic background alerts and alarms.
Analyze your scan history via the Analytics Dashboard, export formal PDF Privacy Audit Reports, and report unknown devices to the global community database.
To detect smart glasses nearby, we need Bluetooth and Location permissions.
Point your camera at the glasses. Look for a tiny LED light flicker on the frame. If a light is on, the glasses are recording.

Complete this 5-step security checklist when entering a new sensitive area to ensure 100% privacy protection.
Run a 60-second real-time scan to identify surrounding smart glasses, Ray-Ban Meta, AR, or spy camera BLE signals.
Point your camera at suspicious glasses frames using AI Visual Scan with Torch to check for flickering recording LEDs.
Check the RSSI Signal Trend chart to identify if the strongest camera signal is within IMMEDIATE (< 1m) range.
Turn on Zone Security Mode for automatic perimeter alerts and background heads-up pop-up notifications.
Tag friendly devices to isolate threats, then export a CSV audit report for your security records.
Spy camera glasses often hide tiny pinhole lenses near the bridge or nose pads. Look for glass reflection or a subtle LED indicator flickering when recording.
Smart glasses (like Ray-Ban Meta or XREAL) have thicker temples near the ears to house batteries, micro-speakers, and camera modules.
People recording with smart glasses often tap or double-touch the right temple frame or tilt their head unnaturally to align the camera field of view.
Before confidential discussions, activate Zone Security Mode, run a quick Radar scan, and ask participants to store smart eyewear.
Using Quick Settings Tile for fast protection
Add the Glasses Scan tile to your Android Quick Settings shade to toggle background scanning with a single tap whenever you enter a new room.

Glasses Scanner is engineered with a strict \'Privacy-First\' philosophy. We do not collect, store, or transmit your personal identification information (PII) or scan results to remote servers. All Bluetooth signal analysis, EMF magnetometer measurements, and history records remain 100% on your local device.

The app requires Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and Foreground Service permissions to perform real-time scanning for nearby camera glasses (Ray-Ban Meta, Snap Spectacles, XREAL, Even Realities G1, Viture, Rokid, Echo Frames, Lucyd, Huawei, Razer, Frame AI, InMo, and Spy Camera Glasses) and hidden RTSP IP cameras on local networks. Crowdsource reports sent by users contain no personal data.

Android OS mandates \'Location\' permission for Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) scanning. Detection coordinates are stored locally on your device to display markers on your personal \'Map\' feature and configure Auto-Zone perimeters. Location data is never uploaded or tracked by Circle Mesh Limited or third parties.
4. Camera, ML Kit & Magnetic EMF Sensors

Camera access is requested solely for the \'AI Visual Scan\' feature using Google ML Kit on-device face analysis to inspect recording LED indicators on suspicious frames. Magnetic sensor data is processed strictly on-device to measure EMF fields. Evidence photos captured are saved directly to your local device gallery (Pictures/GlassesScanner) and are never transmitted remotely.

We use Google AdMob (Google Mobile Ads) for app monetization for free users. Google AdMob may collect device identifiers, IP addresses, and coarse location data to serve personalized or non-personalized ads in accordance with Google\'s Privacy Policy. Premium subscribers enjoy a 100% ad-free experience.

Since all history logs are stored locally, you maintain complete control over your data. You can export your audit logs to formal PDF format or delete all detection records at any time using the \'Clear All\' button. Uninstalling the app permanently removes all local data.
If you have any questions regarding this Privacy Policy or app security, please contact us at support@circlemesh.site. Developed by Circle Mesh Limited.
